Name: Number of Louvres
Label: Number of Louvres
Description: Calculated number of louvre blades. Formula: (ThroatLength_mm - 40) / 133

Name: Geometric Area Av
Label: Geometric Area Av (m²)
Description: Gross geometric opening area in m². Source: aerodynamic!C365

Name: Aerodynamic Area Aa
Label: Aerodynamic Area Aa (m²)
Description: Net aerodynamic area after Cv coefficient and guard correction. Source: aerodynamic!B388

Name: Snow Load
Label: Snow Load (N/m²)
Description: Certified snow load class. Source: snow loads!AA513. May be 'X' if not certified.

Name: Wind Load
Label: Wind Load (N/m²)
Description: Certified wind load class: 1500 / 3000 / 4000 / X. Source: wind loads!AE136

Name: Ambient Temperature Class
Label: Ambient Temperature Class
Description: Certified ambient temperature class: X / T(-05) / T(-15) / T(-25). Source: T(xx)!E72

Name: Release Temperature
Label: Release Temperature (°C)
Description: Thermal release activation temperature in °C. 0 = no release (FX). Source: CO2-bottles!D7

Name: Opening Pressure Ventilation
Label: Opening Pressure – Ventilation (bar)
Description: Daily ventilation opening pressure: MAX(2, table). 'X' = not applicable. Source: Input!C49

Name: Opening Pressure Smoke
Label: Opening Pressure – Smoke/RWA (bar)
Description: Smoke/RWA opening pressure: MAX(2, table). 'X' = not applicable. Source: Input!C50

Name: CO2 Bottle
Label: CO2 Bottle (g)
Description: Required CO2 bottle size in grams: X / 20 / 28 / 40. Source: CO2-bottles!AF109

Name: Weight
Label: Weight (kg)
Description: Total unit weight in kg (base + insulation + control). 'X' = size not in table. Source: weight!C352

Name: U-Value
Label: U-Value (W/(m²K))
Description: Thermal transmittance. 'X' = not certified (CB* bases). Source: U-values!K79
